question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Unable to express feelings clearly
solution: The correct answer is '**Inarticulate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Inarticulate**'. • It means '(used about a person) not able to express ideas and feelings clearly'. [(व्‍यक्ति) जो अपने विचारों और भावों को स्‍पष्‍टता से व्‍यक्त न कर सके, अवाक्‌पटु] • *Example: My meetings with him left me **inarticulate** with rage.* **Correct Answer:__** *Inarticulate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Affluent**: having a lot of money. (धनवान, समृद्घ) • **Eloquent**: able to use language and express your opinions well, especially when you speak in public. (सार्वजनिक प्रसंग में वाणी का प्रयोग करने में दक्ष; वाक्‌चतुर) • **Verbose**: using or containing more words than are needed. (आवश्यकता से अधिक शब्दों से युक्त; शब्दबहुल; शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण) 38:Tc00, The correct answer is '**Stretch**'.
